episodes.153981: Low pressure system moving across the Southeastern U.S. with cold front extending into the Gulf of Mexico causes strong marine winds.
episodes.154867: A series of strong Pacific fronts moved across the region bringing high winds to the coast with heavy rain across much of the area. The heavy rains resulted in flooding of some coastal rivers as well as small stream flooding and a debris flow.

events.narrative: Oregon DOT estimated 70 cubic yards of material block the Historic Columbia River highway between Angels Rest and Multnomah Falls.
The Grays River gage (GRRW1) measured a crest of 12.1 feet.  The flood stage is 12.0 feet.  No damage was reported.
The gage on the Wilson River near Tillamook (TLMO3) crested at 12.4 feet. Flood stage is 12.0 feet.  No damage was reported.
The gage on the Siletz river near Siletz (SILO3) crested at 17.6 feet. Flood stage is 16.0 feet. No damage was reported.
Road closure due to high water on OR-153.
Road closure due to high water over Telford Road between Rugg Road and Sunshine Valley Road near Boring, OR.
The Siuslaw river gage near Mapleton (MPLO3) crested at 18.7 feet. Flood stage is 18.0 feet. No damage was reported.
